messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: billing-metering detected token-count divergence for ingest shard eu1. severity=page, customers_impacted=~12, alerted_groups=#oncall,#billing :rotating_light:
maria_nguyen: seeing a spike in token diffs on the shadow aggregator, started ~23:42 UTC. Investigating consumer lag on kafka-consumer-7.
sam_choi: can you paste the quick delta?
maria_nguyen: delta sample: 
```
customer_id: cust-421, expected: 12457, recorded: 12788, delta: +331
customer_id: cust-892, expected: 4879, recorded: 5200, delta: +321
```
lee_ops: that pattern looks like duplicate replay rather than undercount. consumer offsets show repeated commits from 23:40-23:47. attaching tail of logs: `kafka-consumer-7` -> `ERROR: commit failed, retrying` then lots of `processed message id X` repeats.
devon_oncall: I'm oncall. Paging in. Initial assessment: kafka-consumer-7 flapped and client retried causing at-least-once duplicate processing into shadow-emitter, downstream reconciler overcounted into billing shadow. Not yet seeing writes to master ledger, but overage flags triggered from shadow pipeline.
clare_billing: customers have started to receive pending overage emails (automated notify). Which customers? we need customer impact list now.
maria_nguyen: compiling list, holding at 12 customers. Most are mid-tier with embed-heavy workloads. I'll push IDs to #billing in 2m.
sam_choi: mitigation suggestions: 1) pause shadow-emitter writes (so no further false signals), 2) disable automated overage notify pipeline (temp), 3) backfill dedupe for window 23:35-23:50.
lee_ops: pausing shadow-emitter now: `kubectl patch deployment shadow-emitter -n meter --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":0}}'` -> DONE.
devon_oncall: disabling notify worker: `/svcctl disable billing-notify-shadow` -> ack. Clare, confirm we should stop customer emails immediately?
clare_billing: yes stop emails. send a pause note to support so they don't escalate. Also prepare a cautious customer message saying we're investigating possible duplicate usage signals and will remediate.
maria_nguyen: starting dedupe job (id=dedupe-555) for window 2026-03-20T23:30:00Z -> 2026-03-20T23:55:00Z against shadow ledger. Running on a small batch to validate.
sam_choi: if dedupe reduces counts, we'll mark those overage flags as false-positives and retract emails. If not, escalate.
lee_ops: logs from dedupe-run (preview): `checked 12 accounts, duplicates found: 9, net token correction: -4,102`
devon_oncall: good. next steps: keep master ledger reads/writes untouched, reprocess only shadow aggregates, test with QA set, coordinate customer comms after validation.
clare_billing: I'll draft a short support statement: "We're investigating unusual usage signals affecting reports; we're pausing notifications while we verify. No customer charges have been applied yet."
maria_nguyen: dedupe job finished: `matches:9, corrected_tokens:-4123, affected_overages:7`
sam_choi: great. Can we reconcile with kafka offsets to ensure no late duplicates remain?
lee_ops: consumer fixed (restart applied), offsets forced to latest: `kafka-consumer-7` restarted with consumer_group offsets set to end. No more retries observed.
devon_oncall: marking incident as mitigation-in-progress. Action items: 
- [maria_nguyen] push corrected shadow aggregates to reconcile service (done)
- [clare_billing] pause customer emails & notify support (done)
- [sam_choi] run ledger reconciliation in 30m and verify no writes to master (pending)
- [lee_ops] monitor kafka consumer health for 1h (pending)
clare_billing: support note posted to #support-ops with affected customer list and templated messaging.
maria_nguyen: reconciliation summary (preview): `post-correct counts match expected within tolerance for 11/12 customers, 1 customer has persistent +40 token delta likely from normal burst, not duplicate.`
sam_choi: recommend issuing temporary credits for the 7 customers who saw overage flags (small amounts) to be safe while we audit. Clare, ok to proceed?
clare_billing: yes approve credits for those 7. I'll queue them.
devon_oncall: final: set incident status -> monitoring, will close when post-mortem and customer credits queued. react with :white_check_mark: when you have nothing more to add.
maria_nguyen: leaving next steps in doc: short RCA: consumer retry loop + at-least-once semantics + shadow-emitter writes -> over-flagging. Long-term: add idempotency keys at emitter and better dedupe windowing.
lee_ops: added ticket INFRA-1248 to prevent commit-retry replay.
clare_billing: customers notified with apology, credits queued. closing loop after postmortem.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: severity reduced to monitor. pager resolved."
